BiblicalUsage: Jishpan is Ishpan, an Israelite, a son of Shashak of Benjamin. In 1 Chronicles 8:22, Ishpan, and Heber.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ishpan matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
